> **First open case beyond Erdős–Rado**: $\mathfrak{c} \to (\omega \cdot 2, 4)^3_2$. Erdős and Rado proved $\mathfrak{c} \to (\omega + n, 4)^3_2$ for every finite $n \ge 2$ (see `erdos_rado`), which covers all red ordinals below $\omega \cdot 2 = \omega + \omega$.
